pages.text: $(thing)Root-knot Nematode$() ($(o)Meloidogyne spp.$()), nematode.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() tomato, carrot, potato, lettuce, peanut, soybean, cotton.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 20-33 °C (best 28 °C).
